projects.name: raft-mvcc
projects.tagline: Consensus, serializable snapshots, and machine-checkable histories.
projects.problem: A replicated database can acknowledge writes while violating safety under partitions, leader changes, or transaction conflicts.
projects.mechanism: Raft elections and conflict repair combined with MVCC snapshots, serializable OCC, safe-point GC, and P-compositional linearizability checking.
projects.attack: Seeded partitions, stale candidates, minority leaders, conflicting transactions, tombstones, and invalid histories.
projects.proof: Five-node failover completes in 11 simulator ticks while minority leaders cannot commit.
projects.limitation: An in-process simulator: no sockets, fsync, snapshots, membership changes, or multi-range transactions.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/raft-mvcc && cd raft-mvcc && make test

projects.name: columnar-engine
projects.tagline: Vector-at-a-time analytical execution checked against scalar oracles.
projects.problem: Analytical operators can be fast while silently mishandling nulls, selections, joins, or aggregation.
projects.mechanism: Null bitmaps, selection vectors, vectorized filters, joins, aggregation, and TPC-H Q1.
projects.attack: Every vectorized operator is differentially checked against a scalar reference.
projects.proof: 6,288 assertions; batched filters are 1.94x the scalar implementation.
projects.limitation: In-memory engine without persistence, distributed execution, or a SQL frontend.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/columnar-engine && cd columnar-engine && make test

projects.name: dst-harness
projects.tagline: Deterministic simulation testing scored by seeds-to-first-catch.
projects.problem: Distributed failures are hard to reproduce when time, network, disk, and scheduling remain nondeterministic.
projects.mechanism: Virtual clock, network and disk, seeded fault injection, Raft safety properties, and a Wing-Gong checker.
projects.attack: Twelve planted Raft defects plus 2,000 clean control seeds.
projects.proof: Seeds-to-first-catch range from 1 to 485; the harness also found two real bugs with reproducing seeds.
projects.limitation: The target protocol model is deliberately smaller than a production Raft implementation.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/dst-harness && cd dst-harness && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
